slides.title: Same output, two inputs. There is a ==2-second== shortcut.

slides.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = 3x − 7. If f(a) = f(2a − 5), what is the value of a?
slides.prompt: Time yourself. Comment your time and your answer.

slides.title: B — 5
slides.body: A line with nonzero slope is one-to-one, so f(a)=f(2a−5) forces the inputs to match: a=2a−5 → a=5. Most students pick A (3): set the input equal to a piece of the formula rather than to the other input.

slides.title: Function Equality (One-to-One Linear)
slides.body: For any linear function with nonzero slope, f(a)=f(b) means a=b — set the inputs equal and skip the algebra.
